headline: In ‘Wanted’ on Broadway, Outlaw Sisters Pass for White to Settle the Score
context: The new musical, set in the late 1800s in Texas, originated from the family lore of the book writer and lyricist Angelica Chéri. Its journey to Broadway took a dozen years.
